ideas.label: Carlsbad Structure
ideas.principle: Let the Carlsbad structure choose the wing
ideas.summary: In the Carlsbad structure, plans come from the fixed central pawn skeleton: a queenside minority attack, central expansion, or a kingside initiative.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]

ideas.label: Carlsbad Structure
ideas.principle: Create a queenside target with the minority
ideas.summary: The minority attack uses fewer queenside pawns to provoke a backward or isolated pawn. Its value depends on open files and piece coordination, not on mechanically pushing pawns.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927

ideas.label: Carlsbad Structure
ideas.principle: Coordinate pieces before the minority break
ideas.summary: Before the Carlsbad b-pawn break, place rooks on the files likely to open and ensure a knight can occupy the weakened c5 or c6 square. If the opponent starts a kingside attack, compare speed rather than assuming the minority attack remains correct.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
